Key findings include: ◦ Nearly 40% of patients alive at three years with Ziihera plus tislelizumab and chemotherapy, irrespective of PD-L1 status, achieving a median OS of 27 months. ◦ Mature HERIZON-GEA-01 results show Ziihera plus chemotherapy delivered statistically significant and clinically meaningful OS benefit, reducing the rate of death by 24% versus trastuzumab plus chemotherapy. ◦ The Ziihera plus tislelizumab and chemotherapy regimen reduced the risk of death by 35% (hazard ratio [HR] 0.65; 95% CI: 0.52–0.80), improving from an HR of 0.72 at the first interim analysis.
